_note: The DSX Scene PHYSICS corpus (dsx-game.md §2 G2), production law. FIXED TICK: simulation advances at exactly 60 Hz (dt=1/60); rendering interpolates previous/current poses; the accumulator clamps to 5 steps and discards excess; on:tick is zero-based and on:frame remains render-rate. DETERMINISM: identical initial state and inputs produce identical 6-decimal outputs in TypeScript, Kotlin and Swift using Double precision, fixed document/pair/feature ordering, and no clock or randomness. STEP ORDER: (1) kinematics consume scene-root pose intents; linear velocity is delta-position/dt and world angular velocity is shortest-arc quaternion delta/dt; moved/rotated kinematics invalidate their cache and can wake sleepers. (2) character move intent sets normalized horizontal velocity. (3) awake dynamic/character bodies integrate linear velocity then position; dynamic bodies integrate world angular momentum L=(Iworld*omega+torque*dt)*max(0,1-damping*dt), advance normalized orientation by the world-omega exponential map, recompute omega=Iworld(new)^-1*L, and expose the nearest equivalent DSX Euler branch. (4) discover solid contacts in document pair order, layer-filtered. Sphere and OBB contacts use point velocities v+omega-cross-r. Box/box is 15-axis OBB SAT with fixed winner order: face winners clip deterministic support faces to at most four provenance-keyed points; edge winners resolve the selected support-edge closest points. Coherent cached accumulated normal/vector-friction impulses warm-start every constraint, then all constraints run 32 global sequential iterations; cache reuse requires stable feature, coherent normal and both body-local anchors. Baumgarte correction follows the velocity solve. (5) characters move-and-slide against static/kinematic bodies for at most four deepest-contact iterations and ground on up.y>0.7. (6) triggers overlap without forces. (7) enter/exit/collision events update. (8) a dynamic body sleeps after 60 ticks with both linear and angular speed below 0.05 and zero torque; writes and energetic contact-surface motion wake it. (8.5) mode=2d retains only world-Z angular inertia and planar XY contact/friction impulses, then re-pins locked pose/velocity components; stale contact cache entries evict; tick increments. CONTACT/CORRECTION: depth zero is not contact; normals point first-to-second; restitution is max bounce with the 0.5 approach-speed guard; Coulomb friction uses sqrt(frictionA*frictionB) and accumulated impulse magnitude; correction is 0.8*max(depth-0.005,0)/inverse-mass-sum. EXTRACTION: static/dynamic/kinematic/character bodies are scene-root citizens. Spheres scale by largest world basis. Boxes use a stable orthonormal root frame and half extents from projecting all eight transformed corners, conservatively containing shear. Frozen extents rotate with solver quaternion. Nested local position/rotation writes and kinematic intents convert through parent world; render poses convert back; rebuilds carry quaternion orientation. WRITES: position/rotation teleport and reset corresponding velocity; linear/angular velocity and torque writes wake and invalidate affected cache. Triggers/layers retain prior laws. Capsule collider and broad-phase acceleration remain named absences. Samples are after their named tick; writes land before it. Floats tolerate 1.5e-6. Every case runs on TypeScript per PR, Kotlin core tests, and Swift RecordMain.
_angular_law: This field is the compact angular counterpart to the complete production operation order in _note. Dynamic bodies store a normalized quaternion orientation and integrate world angular momentum in Double precision: L = (Iworld*omega + torque*dt)*max(0,1-damping*dt), exponential-map quaternion step, then omega = Iworld(new)^-1*L. Public DSX Euler degrees choose the equivalent branch nearest the previous output. Solid-sphere and solid-box diagonal inertia derive from frozen conservative OBB extents. Box contact is 15-axis OBB SAT: face winners clip deterministic support faces to at most four provenance-keyed points; edge winners use closest selected support edges. Point impulses include angular response. A private persistent cache warm-starts accumulated normal/friction impulses only while feature, normal and both body-local anchors remain coherent; global fixed iterations are 32 and stale entries evict each tick. Kinematic omega is the shortest-arc quaternion delta and contact surface omega wakes sleepers. Rotation, angular-velocity and torque writes wake and invalidate affected cache. Sleep requires both linear and angular speed below 0.05 and zero torque. In mode=2d solver inertia is world-Z-only and contact/friction impulses are planar XY. Capsule colliders remain the named absence.
_sleep_law: A sleeping dynamic remains in contact discovery as an immutable solver-static support: effective inverse mass and angular inertia are zero for warm-start, normal, friction and correction terms, while stored physical mass/inertia remain available after a wake. Kinematic, character and genuinely energetic awake-dynamic contact-point motion can wake it. An awake dynamic already accumulating quiet sleep ticks cannot wake a neighbour from its single pre-solve gravity step; a real impact or explicit write resets sleepCount to zero and therefore remains energetic. The staggered three-crate and five-box cases pin convergence plus bit-still poses and zero linear/angular velocity through tick 300.

cases.name: world/defaults — a dynamic sphere pins every physics default
world/static box — auto collider is the world AABB of size/2
world/rotated box — local half extents stay local for the OBB
cases.markup: <scene><box id="crate" physics="dynamic" position="0 1 0" rotation="0 45 0" size="2 2 2" mass="2" bounce="0.25" friction="0.1"/></scene>

cases.name: world/character — speed and jump attrs, box collider from size/2
cases.markup: <scene><box id="hero" physics="character" position="0 0.9 0" size="0.8 1.8 0.8" speed="6" jump="9"/></scene>

cases.name: world/ground plane — local half extents rotate with the OBB
world/trigger + layers + explicit collider sphere override on a box
cases.markup: <scene><box id="coin" physics="static" trigger="true" layer="pickups" collides="player" collider="sphere" position="2 1 0" size="2 2 2"/></scene>

cases.name: world/malformed — unknown physics word skipped, bad mass and gravity default (Article 7)
cases.markup: <scene gravity="down"><box id="a" physics="wobbly" size="1 1 1"/><sphere id="b" physics="dynamic" position="0 2 0" mass="banana"/></scene>

cases.name: world/nested under a transformed parent — root-space body, one diagnostic
world/auto ids — bodies without an id attr get #N in extraction order
cases.markup: <scene><box physics="static" position="0 -0.5 0" size="4 1 4"/><sphere physics="dynamic" position="0 3 0" radius="0.5"/></scene>

cases.name: sim/free fall — semi-implicit Euler under default gravity (v then x)
sim/custom gravity — the scene gravity vector is the integrator's
sim/resting — penetration correction converges, then the body sleeps
sim/restitution ladder — bounce 0, 0.5 and 1 from the same drop
sim/friction — a sliding crate uses multi-point friction and collision torque
sim/kinematic pushes dynamic — the driven body carries its derived velocity
sim/character move-and-slide — a wall removes the into-wall component only
sim/character jump — a velocity write launches; apex and landing ticks pinned
sim/grounded transitions — walking off a ledge drops the flag the step contact ends
sim/trigger — enter and exit tick sequence, no forces applied
sim/sleep — 60 slow ticks sleep the body; a velocity write wakes it
sim/kinematic rest — a STATIONARY kinematic platform lets the sleeper stay asleep
cases._note: the wake law pins ENERGETIC contact only: a kinematic with zero derived velocity never wakes a sleeper (the numbers are the resting case verbatim — with invMass 0 and a zero derived velocity the solver path is identical; only the wake branch could differ, and the tick-239 sleeping:true sample is what kills the always-wake bug)

cases.name: sim/trigger with spaced ids — pair keys never split on author text
cases._note: ids may contain spaces: the pair key separator is NUL (\u0000) on every runner — a space separator mis-splits exit events into phantom ids

cases.name: sim/teleport — a position write moves the body and RESETS its velocity
sim/layers — a filtered pair passes through with no contact and no events
sim/determinism replay — a 120-tick two-body scenario's exact end state
accumulator/a 200 ms frame clamps to 5 steps — the excess is DISCARDED
accumulator/exact 60 Hz frames step once with alpha 0
accumulator/mixed cadence — carry, catch-up and the cap
interpolate/rendered = prev + (curr − prev)·alpha, componentwise
interpolate/alpha 0 is the previous step, alpha 1 the current
parentframe/a rotated, scaled parent — root ⇄ local round-trips exactly
cases._note: THE PARENT-FRAME LAW (G2 x G1): bodies SIMULATE in scene-root space, but a node's position is LOCAL to its parent (the renderer composes parentWorld · local). The solver result converts root → local before it lands on the node; an authored/bus position write converts local → root before it teleports the body. Numbers from an independent scratch derivation of T(2,1,-3)·Ry(90)·S(2).

cases.name: parentframe/a translate-only parent — the prefab-instance case a crate lands in
cases._note: the shape EVERY G1 prefab instance takes: the expansion root carries the instance transform, so a body resting at root height 0.294319 must hold -2.905681 locally under a parent at y 3.2

cases.name: parentframe/a fully rotated parent — the scene origin in the parent's frame
parentframe/a degenerate parent (scale 0) passes the root value through — never NaN
cases._note: Article 7: a non-invertible parent is a value, not a crash — the body renders at its root position rather than vanishing to NaN

cases.name: parentframe/no parent (a scene-root body) is the identity fast path
world/sheared parent conservatively contains every transformed box corner
cases._note: The collider orientation is the stable Gram-Schmidt root frame, while half extents are projections of all eight transformed corners. Non-uniform parent scale plus child rotation may overbound, never underbound.
cases.markup: <scene><group position="3 2 0" rotation="0 0 20" scale="2 1 1"><box id="shear" physics="dynamic" size="2 1 1" position="1 0 0" rotation="0 0 45"/></group></scene>

cases.name: orientationframe/stationary nested kinematic keeps its extracted root pose
cases._note: Kinematic intents are node-local but solver bodies are root-space. Composing through this translated, rotated, non-uniformly-scaled parent reproduces extraction, so tick 1 derives zero false velocity/angular velocity.

world/angular body attrs and box inertia tensor
